name: Spend a few days practicing, playing

system.description: When you **_spend a few days practicing, playing_** **_the flute where the wind can hear you_**, roll +CHA: **on a 10+**, mark 1 circle; **on a 7-9**, mark 1 circle, but you summon an irate zephyr spirit; **on a 6-**, you make no progress but do manage to summon an irate zephyr.

partial.value: mark 1 circle, but you summon an irate zephyr spirit

failure.value: you make no progress but do manage to summon an irate zephyr.
